notes: Batch 3 focused on the school-tax and school-district layer: provincial Residential and Non-Residential School Tax Rates Orders (OIC 124/26 and OIC 122/26), Additional School Tax mechanism, TransLink 2026 Property Tax and Replacement Tax Bylaws, Vancouver School District No. 39 annual/amended budgets and audited financial statements, Conseil scolaire francophone (SD 93) equivalent documents, and the provincial Independent Schools funding rates (Group 1 = 50 % / Group 2 = 35 % of local public district rate). These are the last clear, independently citable report-level nodes supported by primary evidence.

proposed_reports.title: 2026 Residential School Tax Rates Order (OIC 124/26)
proposed_reports.publisher: Province of British Columbia (Lieutenant Governor in Council)
proposed_reports.description: Annual Order in Council under section 119(3) of the School Act setting the residential (Class 1) school tax rate, expressed in dollars per thousand dollars of net taxable value, for each school district in British Columbia for the calendar year.

proposed_reports.title: 2026 Non-Residential School Tax Rates Order (OIC 122/26)
proposed_reports.publisher: Province of British Columbia (Lieutenant Governor in Council)
proposed_reports.description: Annual Order in Council under section 119(3) of the School Act setting the school tax rates for all non-residential property classes (Utilities, Supportive Housing, Major Industry, Light Industry, Business and Other, Managed Forest Land, Recreational/Non-Profit, Farm) province-wide for the calendar year.

proposed_reports.title: Additional School Tax rate (high-value residential properties)
proposed_reports.publisher: Province of British Columbia, Ministry of Finance / Ministry of Education and Child Care
proposed_reports.description: Provincial surtax applied to the residential portion of properties assessed above $3 million (0.2 % between $3–4 million and 0.4 % above $4 million; rates scheduled to rise in 2027). BC Assessment determines applicability; the tax is collected with the regular school tax on the municipal or Surveyor of Taxes notice.

proposed_reports.title: South Coast British Columbia Transportation Authority 2026 Property Tax Bylaw (No. 163-2026) and Replacement Tax Bylaw (No. 164-2026)
proposed_reports.publisher: South Coast British Columbia Transportation Authority (TransLink)
proposed_reports.description: Annual bylaws setting the property-tax and fixed replacement-tax rates levied by TransLink on the net taxable value of land and improvements in the transportation service region; rates are applied by member municipalities on the BC Assessment roll and form part of the property-tax bill.

proposed_reports.title: School District No. 39 (Vancouver) Annual Budget and Amended Annual Budget
proposed_reports.publisher: Board of Education of School District No. 39 (Vancouver)
proposed_reports.description: Annual (and mid-year amended) budget bylaw under the School Act setting estimated revenues, expenses and total budget bylaw amount for the Vancouver public school district, including Ministry operating grants, tuition, and other revenue sources.

proposed_reports.title: School District No. 39 (Vancouver) Audited Financial Statements and Statement of Financial Information (SOFI)
proposed_reports.publisher: Board of Education of School District No. 39 (Vancouver)
proposed_reports.description: Audited consolidated financial statements prepared under the accounting requirements of the Budget Transparency and Accountability Act and accompanying Statement of Financial Information required by the Financial Information Act, covering the Vancouver public school district.

proposed_reports.title: School District No. 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone) Annual Budget and Amended Budget
proposed_reports.publisher: Conseil scolaire francophone de la Colombie-Britannique
proposed_reports.description: Annual and amended budgets for the province-wide francophone public school district (SD 93), prepared under the School Act and reporting Ministry operating grants, other revenues and expenses for French-language education.

proposed_reports.title: School District No. 93 (Conseil scolaire francophone) Audited Financial Statements, SOFI and Financial Statement Discussion & Analysis
proposed_reports.publisher: Conseil scolaire francophone de la Colombie-Britannique
proposed_reports.description: Audited financial statements, Statement of Financial Information and management discussion for the francophone school district, prepared under the Budget Transparency and Accountability Act accounting requirements.

proposed_reports.title: Funding Rates for Independent Schools (Group 1 and Group 2 per-FTE rates)
proposed_reports.publisher: Ministry of Education and Child Care, Independent Schools Branch
proposed_reports.description: Annual table of estimated per-FTE student funding rates for Group 1 (50 % of local public district rate) and Group 2 (35 % of local public district rate) independent schools, published by school district for use in calculating operating grants.

proposed_reports.title: Grants to Independent Schools policy
proposed_reports.publisher: Ministry of Education and Child Care
proposed_reports.description: Official policy describing the operating-grant framework for Group 1 and Group 2 independent schools, including eligibility, percentage rates relative to the local public district, payment schedule and audit requirements.

dependencies.basis: School tax rates are applied to the net taxable assessed values determined under the Assessment Act by BC Assessment.
dependencies.evidence_quote: School tax is charged on every property in B.C. unless the property qualifies for an exemption. ... Current school tax rates * Residential school tax rates: Order in Council 124/2026

dependencies.basis: Non-residential school tax rates are applied to the net taxable assessed values supplied by BC Assessment.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Each year the Province sets the school tax rate for each non-residential property class.

dependencies.basis: BC Assessment determines whether a property is subject to the additional school tax and supplies the assessed values on which the surtax is calculated.
dependencies.evidence_quote: BC Assessment determines if the additional school tax rate applies to your property.

dependencies.basis: TransLink property and replacement taxes are levied on the net taxable value of land and improvements as determined by BC Assessment and are collected by member municipalities on the property-tax bill.
dependencies.evidence_quote: There is assessed and levied on the net taxable value of land and improvements in the transportation service region... a tax at the rates set out in Schedule 1

dependencies.basis: The bulk of Vancouver School District operating revenue is the Ministry of Education and Child Care operating grant, which is funded through the provincial Budget and Fiscal Plan.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Provincial Grants Ministry of Education and Child Care 681,214,860

dependencies.basis: School district financial statements are prepared in accordance with the accounting requirements of the Budget Transparency and Accountability Act (which incorporates public-sector accounting standards).
dependencies.evidence_quote: The accompanying financial statements of School District No. 39 (Vancouver) have been prepared by management in accordance with the accounting requirements of Section 23.1 of the Budget Transparency and Accountability Act of British Columbia

dependencies.basis: The Conseil scolaire francophone receives its primary operating funding as a Ministry of Education and Child Care operating grant under the provincial fiscal framework.
CSF financial statements follow the same Budget Transparency and Accountability Act accounting requirements applied to all British Columbia school districts.
dependencies.evidence_quote: prepared by management in accordance with the accounting requirements of Section 23.1 of the Budget Transparency and Accountability Act of British Columbia

dependencies.basis: Group 1 and Group 2 independent-school per-FTE grant rates are set as fixed percentages (50 % and 35 %) of the local public school district's per-student operating grant amount.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Group 1 = 50 percent of the local district's per-student grant amount Group 2 = 35 percent of the local district's per-student grant amount

dependencies.basis: The annual funding-rate tables implement the percentage-based grant formula set out in the Grants to Independent Schools policy.
dependencies.evidence_quote: This is the primary grant given to Group 1 and 2 independent schools. The grant is determined by the number of FTE equivalent and partially eligible students enrolled in the school.
